rules.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
rules.description: Detects exploitation of public-facing web applications, APIs, and services
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%initial-access%' OR payload ILIKE '%exploit%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Valid Accounts Usage
rules.description: Detects use of legitimate credentials for unauthorized access including default, compromised, and stolen accounts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%defense-evasion%' OR payload ILIKE '%valid-accounts%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Brute Force Authentication
rules.description: Detects brute force authentication attempts including password spraying and credential stuffing
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%credential-access%' OR payload ILIKE '%brute-force%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
rules.description: Detects malicious command/script execution including PowerShell, Bash, Python, and JavaScript
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%execution%' OR payload ILIKE '%command-scripting%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Data Encrypted for Impact (Ransomware)
rules.description: Detects mass file encryption activity consistent with ransomware operations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%impact%' OR payload ILIKE '%ransomware%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Phishing Link Click Detection
rules.description: Detects clicks on known phishing URLs or suspicious links in email and messaging
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%initial-access%' OR payload ILIKE '%phishing%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Scheduled Task/Job Creation
rules.description: Detects suspicious scheduled task or cron job creation for persistence or execution
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%persistence%' OR payload ILIKE '%scheduled-task%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Application Layer Protocol Abuse (C2)
rules.description: Detects suspicious use of HTTP, DNS, or other application protocols for C2 communication
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%command-and-control%' OR payload ILIKE '%protocol-abuse%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Impair Defenses — Security Tool Disable
rules.description: Detects attempts to disable or impair security tools including AV, EDR, and logging
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%defense-evasion%' OR payload ILIKE '%impair-defenses%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Account Discovery
rules.description: Detects account enumeration and discovery activity on domain controllers and directory services
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%discovery%' OR payload ILIKE '%account-discovery%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
rules.description: Detects exploitation of remote services including RDP, SSH, SMB, and database services
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%lateral-movement%' OR payload ILIKE '%remote-exploit%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Process Injection
rules.description: Detects process injection techniques including DLL injection, process hollowing, and thread injection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%defense-evasion%' OR payload ILIKE '%process-injection%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: OS Credential Dumping
rules.description: Detects credential dumping tools and techniques including Mimikatz, LSASS access, and /proc/*/mem

rules.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration over non-standard protocols including DNS, ICMP, and HTTPS to unknown destinations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%exfiltration%' OR payload ILIKE '%alternative-protocol%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
